text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
zh: 在这个播客节目中，

text: we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助你学习。

text: I'm Georgie.
zh: 我是Georgie。

text: And I'm Beth.
zh: 我是Beth。

text: You can find a video of this podcast and a worksheet
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这期播客的视频和练习表，

text: to help you learn on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 帮助你学习，网址是bbclearningenglish.com。

text: Hi Beth, how are you today?
zh: 嗨，Beth，你今天怎么样？

text: I'm good, thank you.
zh: 我很好，谢谢。

text: I am very busy.
zh: 我非常忙。

text: I have a lot of meetings.
zh: 我有很多会议。

text: How are you?
zh: 你呢？

text: I'm OK, thank you, Beth, I don't have many meetings today.
zh: 我还好，谢谢你，Beth，我今天没有很多会议。

text: But today we are talking about meetings,
zh: 不过今天我们要聊的是会议，

text: in particular work meetings where you talk to colleagues
zh: 特别是那种和同事交流、

text: and discuss ideas or make decisions.
zh: 讨论想法或做决定的工作会议。

text: That's right.
zh: 没错。

text: OK.
zh: 好。

text: Shall we get started?
zh: 我们开始吧？

text: Yes.
zh: 好的。

text: So, Beth, you have a lot of meetings today.
zh: 那么，Beth，你今天有很多会议。

text: Do you generally have a lot of meetings at work?
zh: 你平时工作中会议多吗？

text: It really depends on what I'm working on.
zh: 这真的要看我在做什么项目。

text: So if I have a project
zh: 如果我有一个项目，

text: where I need to meet a lot of people,
zh: 需要见很多人，

text: then I might have quite a few meetings.
zh: 那我可能会有相当多的会议。

text: And that's why I'm busy now.
zh: 这也是我现在这么忙的原因。

text: But generally,
zh: 但一般来说，

text: we have a lot of, a few meetings together
zh: 我们团队之间会有一些会议，

text: as a team.
zh: 作为一个团队。

text: But I don't think we have loads of meetings.
zh: 但我不觉得我们的会议特别多。

text: Compared to other jobs, I don't think we have many meetings.
zh: 和其他工作相比，我觉得我们的会议不算多。

text: Most of our work is producing things
zh: 我们大部分工作是制作内容、

text: and editing and writing.
zh: 编辑和写作。

text: But you're right.
zh: 不过你说得对。

text: When there are lots of big projects
zh: 当有很多大项目时，

text: that we need to talk to other people on the project,
zh: 我们需要和项目里的其他人沟通，

text: we have more meetings.
zh: 那时会议就会多一些。

text: But yeah, like you, it really depends.
zh: 不过就像你说的，真的要看情况。

text: I think when you need to brainstorm .
zh: 我觉得当你们需要头脑风暴的时候会议特别有用。

text: So, brainstorm is when you have lots of new ideas
zh: 头脑风暴就是你有很多新想法，

text: and you need to talk about them together.
zh: 需要大家一起讨论。

text: I think then meetings are really useful
zh: 我觉得这种时候开会特别有用，

text: because you hear lots of new ideas,
zh: 因为你能听到很多新想法，

text: and when you're in a room with other people,
zh: 当你和其他人在同一个房间里时，

text: if, for example, I have an idea and you say, that's good,
zh: 比如说，我有一个想法，你说这个想法不错，

text: and we can also do this and we can all
zh: 我们还可以这样做，大家可以一起

text: work together,
zh: 合作，

text: and I think those kind of meetings are really useful.
zh: 我觉得这种会议真的很有用。

text: Yeah, I think that way of doing it is also
zh: 是的，我觉得这种方式也

text: more efficient.
zh: 更高效。

text: So sometimes it's better to just have one hour,
zh: 所以有时候只需要花一个小时，

text: come up with ideas and decide on the ideas.
zh: 提出想法并做出决定就够了。

text: Yeah, definitely.
zh: 是的，确实如此。

text: Do you tend to speak up in meetings?
zh: 你在会议上会主动发言吗？

text: So, that means do you ask questions
zh: 也就是说，你会提问，

text: and feel confident to speak?
zh: 并且有信心表达自己吗？

text: I think,
zh: 我觉得，

text: if the meeting has lots of people,
zh: 如果会议上人很多，

text: I find it a bit more stressful to speak up
zh: 我会觉得发言有点有压力，

text: because I get a bit nervous to speak in front of lots of people.
zh: 因为在很多人面前讲话我会有点紧张。

text: But if it's a meeting with just our team,
zh: 但如果只是我们团队内部的会议，

text: for example, you guys I like and trust.
zh: 比如说，和你们这些我喜欢并信任的人一起，

text: I don't mind
zh: 我就不太介意

text: speaking up that much.
zh: 主动发言。

text: And sometimes we have meetings
zh: 而且有时候我们会

text: in person .
zh: 面对面开会，

text: Sometimes you have meetings on a call.
zh: 有时候是打电话开会。

text: So a video call.
zh: 也就是视频通话。

text: Do you prefer meeting
zh: 你更喜欢

text: in person or having calls?
zh: 面对面开会还是打电话开会？

text: I think I prefer meetings in person
zh: 我觉得我更喜欢面对面开会，

text: because you can, you can kind of see
zh: 因为你可以更容易看到

text: the facial expressions and body language more easily,
zh: 面部表情和肢体语言，

text: I think.
zh: 我是这么觉得的。

text: And it's easier to know
zh: 而且更容易知道

text: when a person wants to speak,
zh: 什么时候有人想发言，

text: these kinds of things.
zh: 诸如此类的事情。

text: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

text: No, I agree with what you're saying.
zh: 不，我同意你说的。

text: A lot of the meetings
zh: 我最近参加的很多会议

text: that I have had recently have been with people
zh: 都是和

text: in different time zones in different countries.
zh: 不同国家、不同时区的人开的。

text: So definitely then
zh: 所以在这种情况下，

text: a call is better because
zh: 打电话肯定更好，因为

text: it's the, the best way to speak without
zh: 这是不用去不同国家

text: having to go to different countries.
zh: 就能沟通的最好方式。

text: But I agree, I think it's nice
zh: 不过我同意，我觉得

text: to be able to see body language
zh: 能更清楚地看到肢体语言

text: better
zh: 这一点，

text: in a face-to-face meeting.
zh: 面对面开会确实不错。

text: But meetings on calls now are so normal
zh: 但现在电话/视频会议已经很普遍了，

text: that there's not loads of difference.
zh: 其实差别也没那么大。

text: It is also really nice
zh: 另外还有一点很好，

text: to be able to take calls in your own house.
zh: 就是可以在自己家里接会议电话。

text: So, working from home can be really nice because
zh: 所以居家办公其实挺不错的，因为

text: you can have your snacks and drinks nearby.
zh: 你可以把零食和饮料放在身边。

text: So yeah, they both have their pros and cons.
zh: 所以呢，两种方式各有利弊。

text: That's true. OK, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation,
zh: 确实如此。好，我们来回顾一下这次对话中出现的表达，

text: starting with brainstorm ,
zh: 先从brainstorm（头脑风暴）说起，

text: which is when you get together with a group of people
zh: 意思是和一群人聚在一起

text: to come up with ideas.
zh: 想出各种点子。

text: If you speak up in a meeting,
zh: 如果你在会议上speak up（主动发言），

text: you express your opinion using your voice.
zh: 就是用你的声音表达自己的看法。

text: In an in-person meeting,
zh: 在in-person meeting（面对面会议）中，

text: everyone is in the same physical place.
zh: 每个人都在同一个物理空间里。

text: We can also call this a face-to-face meeting.
zh: 我们也可以称之为face-to-face meeting（面对面会议）。

text: And we also talked about having a call.
zh: 我们还聊到了having a call（打电话/通话）。

text: This could be a phone call or a video call.
zh: 这可以是电话通话，也可以是视频通话。

text: And we can also describe this as a remote meeting.
zh: 我们也可以把它称为remote meeting（远程会议）。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。

text: Why not test what you've learned using the worksheet
zh: 不妨利用我们网站上的练习表

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 来测试一下你学到的内容，网址是bbclearningenglish.com。

text: And we'll be back next week with another conversation
zh: 我们下周会带着另一段

text: in easy English.
zh: 简单英语对话回来。

text: See you then.
zh: 到时候见。

text: Goodbye.
zh: 再见。
